approved.description: Its latest approval; none before the first.

body.description: With getDPIA: the latest version's text, or Fyniq's draft, as Markdown.
examples:
# Data protection impact assessment of the payroll link
...

entry_id.description: The inventory entry it assesses, if any.

from.description: What the latest version came from: fyniq-dpia-draft@1, or organisation.

key.description: The assessment: payroll, ai-assistant, or other-<uuid> for the organisation's own.

required.description: true when the processing it assesses goes on now: its feature is switched on, or the inventory entry it assesses is open and needs one.

sources.description: With getDPIA: the official sources Fyniq's draft was written from.

examples: Data protection impact assessment of the payroll link

unapproved.description: true while its latest version (or Fyniq's draft) is not approved.

version.description: Its latest version; 0 while it is Fyniq's draft. The ETag carries it for If-Match.

why.description: Why it is required, or when it will be.
